Which 5 artists have the most albums?

tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH counts AS (
  SELECT Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name, COUNT(Album.AlbumId) AS album_count
  FROM Artist LEFT JOIN Album USING(ArtistId)
  GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId
),
distinct_counts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT album_count FROM counts ORDER BY album_count DESC
),
cutoff AS (
  SELECT album_count AS cutoff_count FROM distinct_counts LIMIT 1 OFFSET 4
)
SELECT ArtistId, Name, album_count
FROM counts
WHERE album_count >= COALESCE((SELECT cutoff_count FROM cutoff), 0)
ORDER BY album_count DESC, Name;"}

The five artists with the most albums (by number of Album rows per Artist) are:

- Iron Maiden — 21 albums
- Led Zeppelin — 14 albums
- Deep Purple — 11 albums
- Metallica — 10 albums
- U2 — 10 albums

Note: Metallica and U2 are tied with 10 albums each (they share the same rank).
